name: A Scroll from Mauren
summary: Gaxim Rustfizzle needs arcane help to trigger his NG-5 explosives from afar. He sends you to Collin Mauren in Stormwind, where gnomish ingenuity meets human arcane craft.

sections.title: A Spark Across Distances
sections.body: Gaxim Rustfizzle seeks a safer way to set off his NG-5 explosives. Mechanical fuses cannot give him the remote trigger he wants: one button should ignite the charges while he stays at a safe distance. He turns to arcane magic to bridge that gap.

sections.title: The Mage Quarter Connection
sections.body: Gaxim sends you to Collin Mauren in Stormwind's Mage Quarter for the needed spellwork. Mauren is a human spellcaster whose practical knowledge of the arcane may help bind an explosive ignition to a distant command. His work begins the incantation Gaxim needs for his dangerous project.

faq.q: Who sends me to Collin Mauren?
aliases: who gives a scroll from mauren
faq.answer: Gaxim Rustfizzle sends you to Collin Mauren. He needs an arcane formula from his human acquaintance to finish a remote detonator.

faq.q: Where can Collin Mauren be found?
faq.answer: Collin Mauren is in Stormwind City's Mage Quarter. Look for him among the instructors, apprentices, and arcane researchers around the district's towers and shops.

faq.q: Why does Gaxim need a spell for an explosive device?
faq.answer: Gaxim wants to set off his NG-5 explosives with one button from a safe distance. He seeks Mauren's arcane knowledge for an instant remote trigger because mechanical means can be cumbersome or unreliable over long ranges.

NG-5, or Nitromirglyceronium, is a volatile explosive brewed by Gaxim's old colleague Lomac Gearstrip in Ironforge. Gaxim needs a remote detonation system so the person setting it off can stay well beyond the blast radius.

faq.q: What comes next after speaking with Collin Mauren?
aliases: what follows a scroll from mauren
faq.answer: After Collin Mauren considers the request for a distant detonation spell, he asks you to help him in Westfall in Devils in Westfall.

faq.q: Is Collin Mauren a gnome or a human?
faq.answer: Collin Mauren is a human mage. Gaxim notes that Mauren should be easy to spot among the crowds in Stormwind because he is human.

angles.text: As a mage, you know that the Kirin Tor and Stormwind's arcane practitioners work with engineers. They apply evocation and transmutation to mechanical problems.
As a gnome, you are never shy about joining technology with sorcery when it promises a more catastrophic explosion from a comfortable distance.
As an engineer, you know that volatile black powder and arcane catalysts can solve problems such as remote ignition.
As an Alliance member, you see gnomish tinkerers working with the human wizards who study in Stormwind's Mage Quarter.
